name: Original Prusa MINI Enclosure
description: Original Prusa MINI Enclosure is an accessory that houses your Original Prusa MINI and provides a stable printing environment with increased temperatures, which makes printing from advanced materials, such as PC Blend, Nylon, PP, ASA, and more, easier (prevents warping). The MINI Enclosure also lowers printer noise and covers every moving part of your printer, increasing its safety. A USB port is located on the front of the Enclosure, so you can easily connect a flash drive without opening the Enclosure door. We also prepared various add-ons that can improve your Enclosure even further. If you choose the LED Strip or Advanced Filtration System, we will automatically add the needed PSU for $37.99. The PSU can power the Advanced Filtration System and LED Strip at once so only one PSU will be added. All add-ons are also separately available for purchase here. The Original Prusa MINI Enclosure is shipped disassembled as a kit.

name: Original Prusa MINI+ Semi-assembled 3D Printer - Enclosure Bundle

The package includes a Smooth PEI print sheet and filament sensor. When you choose the semi-assembled MINI+, you also get complimentary access to our online course: 3D Printing and Modeling for Beginners.

name: Original Prusa MINI to MINI+ upgrade kit
description: Original Prusa MINI to MINI+ upgrade kit contains the SuperPINDA to replace the original M.I.N.D.A. SuperPINDA is temperature-independent, with a higher quality sensor that doesn't need a thermistor; making the first layer calibration and mesh bed levelling much easier and more consistent. Y-axis metal clips aren't included in the upgrade kit. We do not recommend changing them on already assembled printers, as they won't improve print quality. Their only purpose is making the assembly of new printers a little bit easier.
